description: Turns a polyphonic chord into the control voltages that set up a scale on the Non-Octave-Repeating Scale Intervallic Quantizer

params.text: When on, a note an octave multiple above the root is added as the last note of the scale; when off, the highest note of the chord ends the scale

inputs.text: A trigger patched here holds the outputs until the next trigger arrives; it goes high above 2V and low below 0.1V
The polyphonic pitches that define the scale: the lowest note becomes the root, the channel count becomes the scale length, and the gaps between the sorted notes become the intervals

outputs.text: The trigger from the TRIG input passed on, in step with the scale changes made here
The lowest note of the chord as a pitch, to patch into the quantizer's SCALE ROOT input
The scale length as a voltage, to patch into the quantizer's SCALE LENGTH input
One channel per interval between the sorted chord notes, to patch into the quantizer's POLY INTERVALS input

notes: the quantizer needs EQUAL DIVS off, its interval knobs and SCALE LENGTH fully counter-clockwise and SCALE ROOT at noon; its NORSIQ Chord to Scale configuration factory preset sets all that up

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
